chapter: Three Deuces and 52nd Street with Tatum
title: Tatum never got publicity; 52nd Street clubs
summary: He says Tatum was never promoted properly and recalls the clubs next door to each other on 52nd Street.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: How was playing at 52nd street different from other places around the country?

Well, the people didn't listen... Like I said the man never got the right public thing, you know. Pictures in the paper, or something... Why the hell didn't he get a lot of publicity. When we hit a town we just hit a town. You might see a sign "The Art Tatum" trio. But they didn't help. They can get mad with me all they want, I couldn't care less, but they didn't help. They should have pushed, just like they push other people. You know what I mean. If you know you got a good talent, you don't... No publicity. We should have had all kinds of pictures out. The pictures you see now... are so rare you can't get em...
Did you play at the Downbeat with Tatum?
Downbeat, 3 Deuces, Famous Door, Spotlight... Downbeat I don't know.
The clubs on 52nd Street were similar.
Oh yeah they were all the same, right next door to each other. We had the best who had the best drawing power, the best name that's where the people went.
